# password-policy-nist\n\nPassword verifier checks after NIST SP 800-63B-4: length by code points after NFKC, blocklist and context words, and a k-anonymity breach lookup through a port.\n\n## Docs\n\n- [README](README.md): Problem, installation, usage example\n- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model, defended and undefended limits\n- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Design and evaluation pipeline\n- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Test suite coverage and execution
